01运行前的观察目标02同一二维分布：解析 Score、条件均值、两种路径与密度方程03代码说明

运行前先预测关键输出，再对照断言和下方代码说明。核对通过后，尝试只改变一个输入或配置，解释输出为什么变化。

运行前的观察目标

float64 下，两条路径的解析 Score 与 Autograd 最大误差均为 4.45×10⁻¹⁶ 以下，连续性与 VP 前向 Fokker–Planck 误差均为 2.23×10⁻¹⁶ 以下（本次 CPU 观测）。代码还检查共同端点、不同中间密度、路径有限差分和标准 Gaussian 平稳性。这些是解析公式验证，没有训练神经网络；运行记录写入 score_mixture_results.json。

python 25_score-sde_demo.py环境配置

同一二维分布：解析 Score、条件均值、两种路径与密度方程

25_score-sde_demo.py
"""One conditional mixture, two marginal paths, exact score/velocity/PDE checks."""import jsonimport mathfrom pathlib import Pathimport torch torch.set_num_threads(1)torch.set_default_dtype(torch.float64)torch.manual_seed(20261106)MEANS = torch.tensor([[[-1.6, -0.6], [1.6, 0.6]],                      [[-0.6, 1.6], [0.6, -1.6]]])WEIGHTS = torch.tensor([[0.35, 0.65], [0.65, 0.35]])DATA_STD = 0.28  def coefficients(t, path):    # t is ALWAYS noise -> data here. The diffusion forward clock is tau=1-t.    if path == "linear":        return t, 1-t, torch.ones_like(t), -torch.ones_like(t)    if path == "vp":        angle = math.pi*t/2        a, s = angle.sin(), angle.cos()        return a, s, math.pi*s/2, -math.pi*a/2    raise ValueError("path must be linear or vp")  def mixture(x, t, condition, path):    a, s, ad, sd = coefficients(t, path)  # t is a scalar tensor in this example    q = a.square()*DATA_STD**2 + s.square()    means, weights = MEANS.to(x)[condition], WEIGHTS.to(x)[condition]    residual = x[:, None, :] - a*means  # [B,K=2,D=2]    logits = weights.log()-residual.square().sum(-1)/(2*q)    logp = torch.logsumexp(logits, -1)-x.shape[-1]/2*torch.log(2*math.pi*q)    rho = logits.softmax(-1)    score = -(rho[:, :, None]*residual).sum(1)/q    clean_mean = (rho[:, :, None]*(means+a*DATA_STD**2/q*residual)).sum(1)    noise_mean = (rho[:, :, None]*(s/q*residual)).sum(1)    velocity = ad*clean_mean+sd*noise_mean  # conditional expectation, not pair target    return logp, score, clean_mean, noise_mean, velocity  def divergence(vector, x):    return sum(torch.autograd.grad(vector[:, j].sum(), x, create_graph=True,                                   retain_graph=True)[0][:, j] for j in range(x.shape[1]))  def run(output="score_mixture_results.json"):    rows = []    for path in ("linear", "vp"):        x = torch.tensor([[0.2,-0.3], [1.4,0.2], [-1.2,0.4]], requires_grad=True)        condition = torch.tensor([0, 1, 0])        t = torch.tensor(0.4, requires_grad=True)        logp, score, clean, noise, velocity = mixture(x,t,condition,path)        a, s, ad, sd = coefficients(t,path)        exact_score = torch.autograd.grad(logp.sum(),x,create_graph=True)[0]        torch.testing.assert_close(score,exact_score,atol=1e-11,rtol=1e-10)        torch.testing.assert_close(noise,-s*score,atol=1e-11,rtol=1e-10)        torch.testing.assert_close(clean,(x+s.square()*score)/a,atol=1e-11,rtol=1e-10)        from_score = ad/a*x+(ad/a*s.square()-s*sd)*score        torch.testing.assert_close(velocity,from_score,atol=1e-11,rtol=1e-10)         # Continuity equation on the GENERATION clock for both paths.        p = logp.exp()        dpdt = torch.stack([torch.autograd.grad(p[i],t,retain_graph=True)[0]                           for i in range(len(p))])        continuity = -divergence(p[:,None]*velocity,x)        torch.testing.assert_close(dpdt,continuity,atol=1e-11,rtol=1e-9)        row = {"path": path, "score_max_error": (score-exact_score).abs().max().item(),               "continuity_max_error": (dpdt-continuity).abs().max().item()}         if path == "vp":            # Forward tau=1-t: beta(tau)=pi*tan(pi*tau/2)=pi*s/a.            # beta diverges at tau=1: use interior times, not this endpoint formula.            beta = math.pi*s/a            forward_drift = -0.5*beta*x            gradp = torch.autograd.grad(p.sum(),x,create_graph=True,retain_graph=True)[0]            fp = -divergence(p[:,None]*forward_drift,x)+0.5*beta*divergence(gradp,x)            torch.testing.assert_close(-dpdt,fp,atol=1e-11,rtol=1e-9)            torch.testing.assert_close(velocity,0.5*beta*(x+score),atol=1e-11,rtol=1e-10)            row["forward_fp_max_error"] = (-dpdt-fp).abs().max().item()        rows.append(row)     # Endpoints match, intermediate densities differ. No neural net is trained here.    x = torch.tensor([[0.2,-0.3], [1.4,0.2], [-1.2,0.4]])    condition = torch.tensor([0,1,0])    for endpoint in (0.0,1.0):        t = torch.tensor(endpoint)        torch.testing.assert_close(mixture(x,t,condition,"linear")[0],                                   mixture(x,t,condition,"vp")[0])    t = torch.tensor(0.5)    assert not torch.allclose(mixture(x,t,condition,"linear")[0],                              mixture(x,t,condition,"vp")[0])    # Pairwise paths with the SAME fixed noise must not be called Brownian sample paths.    clean, noise = torch.randn(3,2), torch.randn(3,2)    h = 1e-5    for path in ("linear","vp"):        a,s,ad,sd = coefficients(t,path)        ap,sp,_,_ = coefficients(t+h,path)        am,sm,_,_ = coefficients(t-h,path)        finite_difference = ((ap*clean+sp*noise)-(am*clean+sm*noise))/(2*h)        torch.testing.assert_close(finite_difference,ad*clean+sd*noise,atol=1e-9,rtol=1e-9)    # Retain the stationary-Gaussian sign check from the original implementation.    beta = 1.3    stationary_score = -x    forward_drift = -0.5*beta*x    torch.testing.assert_close(forward_drift-0.5*beta*stationary_score,torch.zeros_like(x))    torch.testing.assert_close(-forward_drift+beta*stationary_score,-0.5*beta*x)    result = {"torch":torch.__version__,"device":"cpu","dtype":"float64",              "means":MEANS.tolist(),"weights":WEIGHTS.tolist(),"data_std":DATA_STD,              "checks":rows,"endpoints_equal":True,"middle_paths_differ":True,              "limits":["Analytic identity checks, not trained generation results.",                         "The VP interpolation gives SDE marginals, not Brownian trajectories.",                         "Score-to-output division is only used at interior times."]}    Path(output).write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+"\n")    print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))    return result  if __name__ == "__main__":    run()
